# REX MADDOX LIVE: HOW TO SURVIVE ANYTHING [italic]Two hours of stories, stunts and survival tips, live on stage. Ninety minutes if the garrison wants the hangar back. Suitable for ages ten and up. The beetle segment is suitable for nobody.[/italic]
## TOUR DATES - [bold]83.02.20[/bold] Gateway Station, the Promenade Theatre. [color=#9FE070]SOLD OUT[/color] - [bold]83.04.03[/bold] Flight, the ninth floor conference hall. Rex will rappel from the roof of the building to the stage, if the building agrees. [color=#9FE070]SOLD OUT[/color] - [bold]83.05.17[/bold] Hybrisa Prospera, the Night Gold Casino. [color=#FFD24A]TICKETS LEFT[/color] - [bold]83.06.28[/bold] Bosenmori Basho, the colony hall. Rex has been asked to remove his boots indoors and has agreed. [color=#FFD24A]TICKETS LEFT[/color] - [bold]83.08.09[/bold] Shivas' Snowball, the MegaStruct deck. A special cold weather show. Heating not guaranteed. [color=#FFD24A]TICKETS LEFT[/color] - [bold]83.09.19[/bold] Sorokyne Strata, the outpost canteen, with a translator. Rex has learned one sentence of Russian. He will not tell us what it is. [color=#FFD24A]TICKETS LEFT[/color] - [bold]83.11.04[/bold] Fiorina 161. [color=#FF5050]CANCELLED[/color]. The facility informed us it does not hold public events. Rex offered to do the show for free. The facility repeated itself.
## WHAT YOU WILL SEE - The flare segment. Rex lights a flare on stage and explains, in the time it takes to burn down, everything you can do with a flare. There are more things than you think. - The knife segment. Rex shows every knife he has broken on the show, in order, and tells you how he broke each one. - The audience segment. Rex asks the colony to tell him about the worst thing on their world. He has heard about sandstorms, ice storms, acid rain and a particularly aggressive goose. Tell him yours.
## AFTER THE SHOW Rex signs boonie hats, MREs and anything else you bring, except weapons, which he will not sign and which the venue will not let in. Photographs with Rex are free. Photographs of Rex eating are not permitted.
